{"action":"shell","command":"cd /testbed && python - <<'PYEOF'
import re
p = 'specs/001-transactions/spec.md'
s = open(p).read()

# 1) Header: extend Input, refresh status/created
s = s.replace(
    "**Created**: 2026-10-17\n\n**Status**: Draft\n",
    "**Created**: 2026-10-17 (milestone 2 revision: 2026-09-22)\n\n**Status**: Draft (milestone 2)\n")
old_input = (
    "**Input**: User description: \"Build cachetools.tagged.TaggedCache(maxsize), using the existing\n"
    "LRUCache for bounded storage and preserving all existing cachetools APIs. R01-R03\n"
    "plus Claim-A candidate extension (variant put_no_recency_refresh, 2026-09-21).\"\n")
new_input = (
    "**Input**: User description: \"Build cachetools.tagged.TaggedCache(maxsize), using the existing\n"
    "LRUCache for bounded storage and preserving all existing cachetools APIs.\" Milestone 1: R01-R03.\n"
    "Milestone 2 (retaining R01-R03): R04 invalidate_many, R05 resize, R06 generator tags and\n"
    "persistent detachment. Claim-A candidate extensions (round 1: put_no_recency_refresh, 2026-09-21;\n"
    "round 2: R05 absolute-expiry preservation clarification, 2026-09-22).\n"
)
assert old_input in s, "input block not found"
s = s.replace(old_input, new_input)

# 2) US2: add recency-on-replacement acceptance scenario (Claim-A round 1)
us2_anchor = "- Keys are hashable; unhashable keys raise TypeError on put (standard Python\n  hashing contract).\n"
assert us2_anchor in s
us2_add = (
    "- Overwriting an existing key via put refreshes its LRU recency, making it the\n"
    "  most-recently-used entry (Claim-A candidate extension, round 1, 2026-09-21; adopted into the\n"
    "  baseline by the latest requirement text).\n"
    "- Keys are hashable; unhashable keys raise TypeError on put (standard Python\n  hashing contract).\n"
)
s = s.replace(us2_anchor, us2_add)

# 3) Insert User Story 4 (R04/R05/R06) before "### Edge Cases"
us4 = '''### User Story 4 - Bulk invalidation, capacity resizing, and generator tags (Priority: P2)

A user removes entries by several tags at once with invalidate_many(tags, mode='any'
or 'all'), resizes the live capacity with resize(maxsize) while the cache keeps
surviving entries in their LRU order, and passes tag generators that are consumed
exactly once. Returned values stay fully detached across repeated gets and puts,
including nested lists and dicts.

**Why this priority**: Milestone 2 capability. Bulk invalidation and resizing are
the main operational controls beyond single-tag invalidation; generator support
and persistent detachment close correctness gaps in the core contract.

**Independent Test**: Fully testable by putting tagged entries, calling
invalidate_many in both modes (including the empty-tag case), calling resize up
and down and checking survivors, LRU order, and the reported maxsize, and by
passing a generator as tags and observing it consumed exactly once.

**Acceptance Scenarios**:

1. **Given** entries carrying various tags, **When** invalidate_many(tags,
   mode='any') is called, **Then** exactly the union of entries carrying any
   supplied tag is removed and the number of distinct removed keys is returned.
2. **Given** entries carrying various tags, **When** invalidate_many(tags,
   mode='all') is called, **Then** exactly the entries carrying every supplied
   tag are removed and the number of distinct removed keys is returned.
3. **Given** any cache state, **When** invalidate_many is called with an empty
   tag collection, **Then** zero entries are removed for either mode.
4. **Given** an invalid mode or invalid tags, **When** invalidate_many is
   called, **Then** ValueError is raised and no state changes.
5. **Given** a full cache, **When** resize(smaller) is called, **Then**
   least-recently-used entries are evicted until the capacity fits, survivors
   keep their relative LRU order, and maxsize reports the new capacity.
6. **Given** a non-full cache, **When** resize(larger) is called, **Then** no
   entry is evicted, LRU order is unchanged, and maxsize reports the new
   capacity.
7. **Given** an invalid resize argument, **When** resize is called, **Then**
   ValueError is raised and all state (entries, tags, recency, capacity) is
   unchanged.
8. **Given** a tag generator, **When** put is called with it, **Then** the
   generator is consumed exactly once and the entry carries the deduplicated
   tags it produced.
9. **Given** a stored nested value, **When** get is called repeatedly and other
   puts occur in between, **Then** every returned copy remains detached:
   mutating any returned nested list or dict never changes later results.

---

'''
anchor = "### Edge Cases\n"
assert anchor in s
s = s.replace(anchor, us4 + anchor, 1)

# 4) Edge cases: add milestone-2 edge cases
edge_anchor = "- Unhashable keys raise TypeError on put (standard Python hashing contract).\n"
if edge_anchor not in s:
    # find the last edge-case bullet before "## Requirements"
    m = re.search(r"(## Requirements \*\(mandatory\)\*)", s)
    assert m
    # insert before Requirements
    s = s.replace("## Requirements *(mandatory)*",
                  "- invalidate_many with duplicate tags counts each removed key once.\n"
                  "- resize to the same maxsize is a no-op that preserves all state.\n"
                  "- A tag generator that raises mid-iteration is consumed until it stops; the\n"
                  "  put fails and prior state is unchanged.\n"
                  "- An entry that had an absolute expiry keeps that exact expiry after a resize\n"
                  "  that preserves it; resize never drops or recomputes expiries (R05\n"
                  "  clarification, 2026-09-22).\n"
                  "\n## Requirements *(mandatory)*", 1)
else:
    s = s.replace(edge_anchor,
                  edge_anchor +
                  "- invalidate_many with duplicate tags counts each removed key once.\n"
                  "- resize to the same maxsize is a no-op that preserves all state.\n"
                  "- A tag generator that raises mid-iteration is consumed until it stops; the\n"
                  "  put fails and prior state is unchanged.\n"
                  "- An entry that had an absolute expiry keeps that exact expiry after a resize\n"
                  "  that preserves it; resize never drops or recomputes expiries (R05\n"
                  "  clarification, 2026-09-22).\n", 1)

# 5) Functional requirements: recency-on-replacement under R02
r02_anchor = "- **FR-013**: len(cache) MUST return the number of live entries.\n"
assert r02_anchor in s
r02_add = (
    "- **FR-013**: len(cache) MUST return the number of live entries.\n"
    "- **FR-017**: Overwriting an existing key via put MUST refresh that entry's LRU\n"
    "  recency, making it the most-recently-used entry (Claim-A candidate extension,\n"
    "  round 1, 2026-09-21).\n"
)
s = s.replace(r02_anchor, r02_add)

# 6) Add R04/R05/R06 requirement groups after FR-016 block, before Key Entities
r03_end = "- **FR-016**: Every stored value MUST cost exactly one capacity slot\n  regardless of object size or shape.\n"
assert r03_end in s
r0456 = (
    "\n**R04 - Bulk invalidation (milestone 2)**\n\n"
    "- **FR-018**: invalidate_many(tags, mode='any') MUST remove the union of entries\n"
    "  carrying any supplied tag; mode='all' MUST remove exactly the entries carrying\n"
    "  every supplied tag. The result MUST be the number of distinct removed keys.\n"
    "- **FR-019**: invalidate_many with an empty requested tag collection MUST remove\n"
    "  zero entries for either mode.\n"
    "- **FR-020**: invalidate_many MUST reject an invalid mode or invalid tags with\n"
    "  ValueError before any state change. invalidate(tag) MUST remain compatible with\n"
    "  its existing behavior.\n\n"
    "**R05 - Capacity resizing (milestone 2)**\n\n"
    "- **FR-021**: resize(maxsize) MUST validate maxsize as a positive integer,\n"
    "  excluding bool, before any state change; invalid values MUST raise ValueError\n"
    "  and preserve all state.\n"
    "- **FR-022**: resize MUST preserve surviving entries and their relative LRU order.\n"
    "  Shrinking MUST evict least-recently-used entries; growing MUST NOT evict.\n"
    "- **FR-023**: The maxsize property MUST report the current capacity after any\n"
    "  successful resize.\n"
    "- **FR-024**: A resize that preserves a surviving entry MUST preserve that\n"
    "  entry's absolute expiry (expiry is entry state per R07/R08). A resize that\n"
    "  drops expiries (making entries immortal) or recomputes them from the resize\n"
    "  time MUST NOT satisfy R05 (Claim-A candidate extension, round 2, 2026-09-22).\n\n"
    "**R06 - Tag generators and persistent detachment (milestone 2)**\n\n"
    "- **FR-025**: Tags MAY be passed as generators and MUST be consumed only once\n"
    "  per put call.\n"
    "- **FR-026**: Returned values MUST remain detached across repeated gets and\n"
    "  puts, including nested lists and dicts.\n"
)
s = s.replace(r03_end, r03_end + r0456)

# 7) Key entities: add expiry note
ke_anchor = "- **Recency order**: The LRU ordering over live entries, updated on put (new\n  or replaced) and on get hits; determines which entry is evicted when the\n  cache is full.\n"
assert ke_anchor in s
ke_add = ke_anchor + (
    "- **Capacity**: The current maxsize of the cache; changeable only via resize\n"
    "  (R05).\n"
    "- **Expiry (conditional)**: Where an entry carries an absolute expiry (R07/R08),\n"
    "  it is entry state that resize must preserve verbatim (FR-024).\n"
)
s = s.replace(ke_anchor, ke_add)

# 8) Success criteria: add SC-006
sc_anchor = "  puts have zero observable effect on stored content.\n"
assert sc_anchor in s
sc_add = sc_anchor + (
    "\n- **SC-006**: Milestone-2 behaviors are exact in all tested sequences:\n"
    "  invalidate_many removes exactly the specified entries and returns the\n"
    "  distinct-key count (empty tags remove zero); every successful resize\n"
    "  preserves survivors, their LRU order, and any absolute expiries, and\n"
    "  reports the new capacity; failed resizes and failed bulk invalidations\n"
    "  change nothing; tag generators are consumed exactly once.\n"
)
s = s.replace(sc_anchor, sc_add)

# 9) Assumptions: update recency assumption; add R07/R08 assumption
old_rec = "- Recency semantics: putting a new key makes it most-recently-used; getting a\n  hit makes that entry most-recently-used. (Whether replacing an existing key\n  via put also refreshes its recency is a candidate extension, not part of\n  this baseline; see Out of Scope.)\n"
assert old_rec in s
